rationale: Both reviews are diff/code-grounded with concrete file:line citations and largely valid findings (missing AMD checkmark on the model table, the fabricated reference-count limit, MODEL_ROOT/FLASHINFER nits), but neither hits the ground truth's central, twice-repeated blocking concern (docs build failure) or the 'separate minimax-h3-rocm.md' suggestion. Y comes closer to that theme (flags the recipes.vllm.ai link risk and explicitly ties it to the mkdocs --strict issue and commit 93c0112c) and additionally surfaces a genuinely severe, well-substantiated functional bug (MODEL pointed at the FL2VA partition silently breaking Ref2VA, directly undercutting the 'all tasks work out of the box' claim) that X only partially notices as an undefined-variable issue. X's findings are solid but generally lower-severity/more nitpicky (arithmetic residuals, SKU naming) and miss the FL2VA-partition bug's real severity.
